units.source_text: 我就是在这杂沓之中看到先生的。

en.t: It was amid this bustle that I first saw Sensei.

units.source_text: 那时海边有两家茶屋，自从我偶然去了其中一家，后来就习惯去那家了。

en.t: At that time there were two teahouses by the shore, and after I happened to go into one of them, I fell into the habit of using that one.

units.source_text: 与长谷那一带拥有大别墅的人不同，

en.t: Unlike the people who owned large villas around Hase,

units.source_text: 没有专用更衣棚的避暑客们，就只有使用这种公共的更衣场所了。

en.t: summer visitors who had no private changing huts had no choice but to use this kind of shared changing place.

units.source_text: 他们除了在这茶屋里喝茶、休息之外，

en.t: Besides drinking tea and resting in these teahouses,

units.source_text: 还在这里洗游泳衣，冲净身上的海水，寄存帽子和雨伞等等。

en.t: they also washed their swimsuits there, rinsed the seawater from their bodies, and left hats, umbrellas, and the like in safekeeping.

units.source_text: 我虽然没有泳衣，但也担心自己的随身物品被偷窃，

en.t: Although I had no swimsuit, I was still worried that my belongings might be stolen,

units.source_text: 所以每次下海前都把衣物寄放在那家茶屋里。

en.t: so every time before I went into the sea, I left my clothes at that teahouse.

units.source_text: 1.中国：即“中国地区”，位于日本本州岛西部。

en.t: 1. Chugoku: that is, the Chugoku region, located in the western part of Japan's Honshu island.
